_: Bounded independent V.92 Tables 21/22 CRC sensitivity checks for t_v92jd.cpp.
These anchors target the two 32-bit CRC payload extents, the all-ones preload,
the two polynomial taps and low-bit-first CRC wire order. Existing v92jd
mutations already cover constructor/accessor/unpacker behavior; this suite
only adds the standards-critical pack/CRC alternatives.
